extraction.name: TextVQA
extraction.description: TextVQA is a Visual Question Answering dataset containing 45,336 questions on 28,408 images that require reading and reasoning about text in the image to answer. Images are sourced from the Open Images dataset from categories that tend to contain text (e.g., billboard, traffic sign, whiteboard), and each question-image pair has 10 ground truth answers provided by humans.
extraction.creator: Amanpreet Singh, Vivek Natarajan, Meet Shah, Yu Jiang, Xinlei Chen, Dhruv Batra, Devi Parikh, Marcus Rohrbach
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Images were sourced from Open Images v3 dataset, filtered for images containing text. Questions and answers were collected via human annotators: 1-2 questions per image requiring reading text in the image, with 10 answers collected per question. Quality control included flagging options for bad questions and filtering out poor annotators using hand-crafted questions.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: Questions where a majority of workers marked quality flags (no text in image, not a question, answering doesn't require reading text, or unanswerable) were removed. Bad annotators were filtered out using hand-crafted control questions.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Open Images v3 dataset, filtered to images containing text (e.g., billboard categories), resulting in 28,408 images as the basis for TextVQA.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Crowdworkers were shown images and asked to provide questions requiring reading text in the image, with 10 answers collected per question. Annotators were given quality control options to flag bad questions (no text, not a question, doesn't require reading text, unanswerable). Questions flagged by majority of workers were removed. Hand-crafted questions with known answers were used to identify and filter bad annotators.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: All 10 annotators agree on the most common answer for 22.8% of questions, while 3 or more annotators agree on the most common answer for 97.9% of questions.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: Rosetta OCR system used to produce OCR tokens for images
extraction.rai:dataBiases: Questions were asked by sighted humans, not visually impaired users, which may introduce a bias compared to the intended use case of aiding visually impaired users.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The OCR model fails at detecting text that is rotated, unstructured (e.g., scribbles), or partially occluded. The dataset was collected from specific image categories that tend to contain text, which may limit generalization.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset is intended to support development of VQA models that can assist visually impaired users, who frequently ask questions requiring reading and reasoning about text in images.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, testing, and evaluation of VQA models that require reading and reasoning about text in images; benchmarking progress on text-based visual question answering; encouraging research on text detection and recognition in unconstrained environments.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Images were selected from the Open Images dataset from categories that tend to contain text (e.g., 'billboard', 'traffic sign', 'whiteboard'). Questions were collected requiring reading and reasoning about text in the image, with each question-image pair having 10 ground truth answers provided by humans. Grid-based features are obtained by average pooling 2048D features from the res-5c block of a pre-trained ResNet-152, and region-based features are extracted from the fc6 layer of an improved Faster-RCNN model.
